messages:
support_jess: Heads up — ACME (acct: acme-corp) reporting p99 latency spikes ~11-13s and intermittent 504s starting ~2026-03-15T09:15:00Z. Affected path: /v1/generate (model: redwood/opt-6). Sample req ids: req_abc123, req_def456. Repro curl below. Please triage.

support_jess: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"redwood/opt-6","input":"short prompt"}'
```

deploy-bot: no service deployments in the last 8 hours (checked: services/runtime, services/admission).

sam_oncall: taking. checking ingress and admission metrics now. any traffic ramp or customer-side batch behavior?

support_jess: ACME says they had a burst of automated calls 09:14-09:18, roughly +3x baseline. They are not retrying aggressively (rate=steady).

leah_sre: looking at metrics — cluster-ingress queue length spiked at 09:15 and stayed elevated. Per-shard concurrency for model redwood/opt-6 is 32; shard-7 queue length shows sustained >120 pending requests and many head-of-line waits. p95 is less impacted than p99 which suggests long tail queueing/backpressure.

leah_sre: I also see worker-shard-7 showing high CPU and KV cache misses after a model reload at 08:50. Possible churn causing reduced effective concurrency.

mike_runtime: FYI there was a config tweak to admission headroom calculation rolled earlier this week that reduced allowed in-flight on shards with high cache miss rate — might be too aggressive for sudden bursts. I'll check the calc.

sam_oncall: actionable options: 1) increase per-shard concurrency from 32 -> 64 for redwood/opt-6 (fast mitigation), 2) enable burst pool (if capacity available) for this tenant, 3) route ACME to secondary model-variant with same quality but more replicas. Thoughts?

mike_runtime: option 1 is simplest. headroom bug: when KV cache cold_count > threshold we subtract an extra 20 tokens from concurrency incorrectly. quick patch ready to revert that subtraction.

leah_sre: I can patch admission config for shard-7 now (increase concurrency). Sam, can you confirm we have spare GPU capacity? ops-bot, report current free slots.

ops-bot: free_gpu_slots: 4 in us-east-1. Burst capacity: available.

sam_oncall: ok patching concurrency for shard-7 -> 64 (admin-api). Will monitor p99 and queue length. Rolling now.

sam_oncall: ```
# admin-api call (internal)
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood.ai/v1/shards/7/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -d '{"model":"redwood/opt-6","concurrency":64}'
```

deploy-bot: config-change: shard-7 concurrency updated by sam_oncall at 2026-03-15T09:23:05Z. No service restart required.

leah_sre: within 2m queue length down from ~120 -> ~10. p99 trending down from 12.1s -> 750ms (observed at 09:25).

mike_runtime: still want to deploy a small fix to headroom calc — will open PR to remove the extra subtraction and add a test. Target hotfix in ~30m.

anna_cs: I messaged ACME with interim mitigation and ETA for permanent fix. They appreciate the quick workaround.

sam_oncall: monitoring for 15m. If stable, we'll keep increased concurrency and roll the headroom fix later today in a canary.

support_jess: updating ticket with repro, mitigation steps (concurrency bump), and next steps (runtime PR + canary). Thanks team :thumbsup:
